# SiteRefresh

> SiteRefresh builds simple one-page websites for New Zealand businesses that have good Google reviews but no website. $49 NZD a month, no setup fee, no GST, no contract, and the owner sees a free mock-up before deciding.

SiteRefresh is run by Mike Llewellyn in Auckland, New Zealand. There is no call centre or sales team; texts and emails go to Mike directly.

## What a customer gets

- A one-page website on the business's own .co.nz address
- The business's Google stars and reviews shown on the page
- A tap-to-call button on phones
- Quote requests sent straight to the owner's mobile
- Small changes done on request by text (new photo, new service, holiday hours)
- Hosting and security looked after

## How it works

1. Mike builds a free mock-up from the business's public Google profile: name, services, area, reviews and photos. The owner writes nothing.
2. Mike texts the owner a link. The owner asks for changes, or says no and that is the end of it.
3. If the owner wants it, the site goes live on their own .co.nz address. They pay $49 at the start of each month and can stop at any time; the site comes down at the end of the last paid month.

SiteRefresh does not promise more work. The site helps customers who have already found the business on Google trust it and get in touch.
